evidence.title: README (segment 2)
evidence.excerpt: If you want to enforce the `eas-cli` version for your project, use the `"cli.version"` field in **eas.json**. Installing `eas-cli` to your project dependencies is strongly discouraged because it may cause dependency conflicts that are difficult to debug.
